items.title: Formally Guaranteed Policy Transfer for Reinforcement Learning in Continuous Spaces
items.abstract_or_text: Synthesizing reinforcement learning policies using Deep Q learning for continuous-space systems is one of the common goals in robotic applications. But using DQN based policies lack formal guarantees on convergence to optimal policy. One can use tabular Q-learning methods which has optimal policy convergence guarantees. However, directly transferring tabular Q-learning policies to continuous environments introduces a severe sim-to-real dynamic mismatch, frequently resulting in catastrophic specification violations. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework that formally bounds spatial drift without requiring hyper-conservative grid resolutions. A high-level Q-learning agent synthesizes an optimal policy on a highly tractable discrete state-space, while a low-level robust tracking controller forces the continuous physical plant to adhere to the discrete trajectory within a strict \epsilon-tube. By actively suppressing this sim-to-real divergence, we mathematically guarantee that the transferred continuous execution strictly satisfies the original temporal and stability specifications, while maintaining a formally bounded O(\epsilon) optimality loss relative to the ideal discrete Q-value. The efficacy of the proposed framework is demonstrated through experiments on three nonlinear robotic environments: an omnibot, a 2-DOF helicopter, and an inverted pendulum. Videos of the experiments are available at https://tinyurl.com/2e5c89be{link}https://tinyurl.com/2e5c89be.
items.summary_zh: 论文提出分层强化学习框架：在离散状态空间用表格 Q-learning 合成策略，再以鲁棒跟踪控制器约束连续系统贴合离散轨迹。作者声称可在明确的 ε 管内控制离散—连续偏差，从而保持原时序与稳定性规范，并给出相对离散 Q 值的 O(ε) 最优性损失界；实验覆盖全向移动机器人、2-DOF 直升机和倒立摆。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将策略迁移的形式化规范满足性、误差界和连续控制实验放在同一任务设置中。其结论仍为公开审稿稿件中的作者主张，但问题、保证对象与实验系统均较明确，便于后续核验。
items.abstract_zh: 使用 Deep Q learning 为连续空间系统合成强化学习策略，是机器人应用中的常见目标之一。但使用基于 DQN 的策略缺乏收敛到最优策略的形式化保证。人们可以使用具有最优策略收敛保证的表格 Q-learning 方法。然而，直接将表格 Q-learning 策略迁移到连续环境会引入严重的仿真到现实动力学失配，并经常导致灾难性的规范违反。为弥合这一差距，本文提出了一种分层强化学习框架，无需采用过度保守的网格分辨率即可对空间漂移给出形式化界限。高层 Q-learning 智能体在高度易处理的离散状态空间上合成最优策略，而低层鲁棒跟踪控制器迫使连续物理对象在严格的 ε 管内遵循离散轨迹。通过主动抑制这种仿真到现实的偏差，我们在数学上保证迁移后的连续执行严格满足原始的时序和稳定性规范，同时相对于理想离散 Q 值维持形式化有界的 O(ε) 最优性损失。所提框架的有效性通过三个非线性机器人环境上的实验得到展示：全向移动机器人、2-DOF 直升机和倒立摆。实验视频见：https://tinyurl.com/2e5c89be。

review.note: 仅 1 项达到质量阈值；其 OpenReview 状态为公开审稿中，摘要明确给出形式保证、误差界和三类非线性机器人实验。
